title: A Prayer for the Mind That Won't Slow Down
hook: If your thoughts won't slow down, stay for this prayer.
script: If your thoughts won't slow down, stay for this prayer. Father, You know every worry this person is carrying. Your Word tells us to bring our needs to You. So we release what we cannot control. Give us wisdom for today, peace for this moment, and courage for the next step. Guard our hearts and minds in Christ Jesus. In Jesus' name, amen.
